title: Melernil Faal'Armanna
summary: Clear the phoenix island, then defeat firesurgers, windsurgers and Melernil Faal’Armanna.
overview: Clear the phoenix island, then defeat firesurgers, windsurgers and Melernil Faal’Armanna.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Clear all twenty designated island creatures to summon four phoenix firesurgers.
Defeat the four firesurgers to summon four windsurgers. Defeat those to bring out Melernil or the cooldown replacement.
Melernil may clear hate every twelve seconds. Prepare tanks to regain control throughout the final fight.
Victory can summon the Avatar of Mist. The event has a three-hour failure timer.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
